Control over game data

Pixel Heist does not require a separate Oyri Games account in the current build. Local saves stay on your device. The options below explain how to manage game data, service permissions, and support requests.

Advertising and tracking choices

The reviewed development build does not connect to a real advertising network. Ad and purchase flows use test providers. These controls will be updated before a build with real services is released.

Access, correction, and deletion

Use the support address to ask about game-related data, request access, or request deletion. Include the game name and platform. Provide the relevant installation identifier if known; do not send passwords or card details.
